services.desc: Cooper Hewitt welcomes K-12 classes to experience design at the museum. Our Design Field Trips explore how design shapes and is shaped by our everyday lives. Students are guided by a Cooper Hewitt educator through discussions and activities in the museum’s exhibitions paired with a hands-on workshop that immerses students in the design making process.
